title: RBI Penalty Order on Sammaan Finserve Limited for Non-Compliance with CRILC Reporting
description: <cite index="18-3,18-4">RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹4.20 lakh on Sammaan Finserve Limited for non-compliance with directions on Early Recognition of Stress and Reporting to CRILC, as the company failed to report credit information of its borrower to Central Repository of Information on Large Credits</cite>.
